_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade. Once there, use the Shrine Bauble. You must speak with Tajarri at the shrine afterwards in order to complete the trial.

Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located. Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves.…
Return to Thunder Bluff and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.
Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.
Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.
Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
Collect 5 Prospector's Picks. At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools. Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.
Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.

Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.
Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.

Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge. Stop at the orc outpost across the bridge. Give Kargal Battlescar at the Barrens outpost your recruitment letter.
Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost. At the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south. Find Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
